meta.title: Luiz Obara — Full-Stack Developer
meta.description: Portfolio of Luiz Obara, a full-stack developer based in Sorocaba, Brazil: web, automation (RPA), data engineering and back-end.

hero.name: Luiz Obara
hero.lead: I build products end to end — interfaces in Next.js and Angular, APIs and automations in Python and Java — with the mindset of someone who also takes care of the infrastructure and the data.

about.title: From pixel to server, with care at every layer.
paragraphs: I'm Luiz, a developer with a degree in Systems Analysis and Development from Facens. My path brings together IT infrastructure, front-end development, data engineering and process automation.

Today I build Python bots with BotCity integrated with SAP and SharePoint, and I teach programming and Artificial Intelligence to young people. Having worked in infrastructure shapes how I develop: I think about deployment, stability and whoever will maintain the system next.

experience.title: Where I've been building.
experience.lead: Automation, data, development and infrastructure: real projects, real users and systems that need to stay up.

bullets: I build and deploy Python automations with BotCity, orchestrating scheduled routines and eliminating recurring manual work.
I integrate bots with SAP to run transactions and extract operational data, reducing rework and typing errors.
I build ETL pipelines across SAP, spreadsheets and SharePoint, delivering standardized datasets to business teams.

items.role: Technology Instructor / Programming and AI Workshop Leader
bullets: I teach programming logic and Python in Google Colab to young people in socially vulnerable situations.
I lead modules on introductory Artificial Intelligence, advanced digital literacy and Microsoft Office.
I prepare students for the job market, guiding them in building their professional profiles on LinkedIn and Burh.
Worked on an end-to-end ELT pipeline, from extraction with Python and Selenium to making data available for analysis.
Modeled the data warehouse with dbt on PostgreSQL and orchestrated the loads with Apache Airflow.
Delivered Metabase dashboards to leadership and deployed the solution on Linux with Docker Compose.
Built the front-end of a new corporate web chat and managed the internal platform used by about 300 people.
Contributed to the front-end of a cosmetics e-commerce store and built internal systems, such as a ticketing portal.
Managed servers, mailboxes and Active Directory users, providing level 2 technical support.
Operated network administration tools (Active Directory, DHCP and Intelligent Management Center) supporting the city hall network.
Assisted public servants by phone, email and in person, solving access and connectivity incidents.
Performed preventive maintenance, replacement and repair of equipment for supermarket chains in the Sorocaba region.
Supported the planning and maintenance of our clients' network infrastructure.
